Ingredients

  • 1 cup chicken broth
  • 1/2 large juicy lemon
  • 2 Table Spoon Sugar
  • 1 tablespoon Corn/Potato Starch
  • 1 tablespoon Water
  • 1 tablespoon honey (optional)

Special Tools

  • Zester or peeler and sharp knife

  1. Get Saucepan and pour in broth. Turn on low heat.

  2. Meanwhile. Get your lemon and make a cut in the surface to mark half. Do not cut in half yet. Zest half the lemon. Put the lemon zest on the side.

Note: If you don't own a zester or similar fine grater, use your peeler to carefully peel half the lemon avoiding the pith. Finely dice the lemon peel and put in on the side.

3.Take the naked half of your lemon and cut it off. Cut a very thin slice off and throw in saucepan.

4.Juice naked lemon half. You'll get about 1/4 cup juice. Add juice to saucepan.

5.Add Sugar. Stir sugar to dissolve.

6.Add honey. Stir till dissolved.

7.Taste sauce to check for sweetness. If too sour add more sugar.

8.Remove lemon slice and add the lemon zest. Stir so more.

9.Mix the starch and water. Add to saucepan slowly, stirring as you go.

10.Sauce should thicken. You want a maple syrup flow.

11.Sauce is done. It's very stable and won't seperate or crystalize too much. Refrigerate.
